correctness.rationale: The quantified finite statement covers every step set for 1 <= n <= 14. The exact signed integral boundary Smith calculation exhausts all 338 connected nonempty-step cases at n=3..14, with only six n=14 cases having a single nonunit factor 2 in the triangle-to-edge map. For each such case the exact boundary ranks give reduced free rank 1 in H1, zero elsewhere. Disconnected graphs are unions of copies of smaller circulants of at most seven vertices, whose independence complexes are torsion-free by the same verified census, and their joins remain torsion-free by the integral Kunneth formula. An independent direct-subset verifier checks all 14 free-face collapses for the nonpure representative; the two residual complexes satisfy edge and vertex-link manifold conditions, connectivity, Euler zero and an explicit orientation contradiction, so each is a Klein bottle. Unit-multiplication maps the six step sets into exactly two degree-distinct graph classes. All critical computations and certificate files were executed from the included paths; no infinite-range or independent certification is asserted.

originality.rationale: The exact theorem is a first-order classification for every connected and disconnected circulant step set on up to 14 vertices, with six exceptional labeled step sets in two degree-distinct orbits and a nonpure collapsible exceptional type. Datta--Upadhyay already provides the full pure Q_{7,2} triangulation after an explicit cyclic relabeling; that individual case is expressly not claimed original. Adamaszek covers all flag complexes only through 12 vertices, and Earl--Vander Meulen--Van Tuyl classify combinatorial properties of well-covered circulants rather than the present all-circulant integral torsion threshold. No stronger or equivalent complete result was identified in the inspected literature and published record searches. Unindexed priority risk remains.
residual_risks: A non-indexed or unpublished complete integral torsion census of small circulant independence complexes might duplicate the threshold.
A database not exposing its Smith invariant columns through textual search could record the same six exceptional step sets.
The pure seven-regular Klein-bottle example is already published and must not be presented as newly discovered.

value.rationale: The first graph order at which a natural symmetry-restricted class of flag complexes exhibits integral homology torsion is a motivated exact extremal problem. The theorem proves a sharp cutoff across all 338 connected presentations and disconnected reductions, classifies both degree-distinct exceptional orbits, and shows that a nonpure 3-dimensional graph independence complex collapses to a Klein-bottle triangulation. This distinction is additional to the published 14-vertex regular Klein-bottle example and goes beyond isolated graph examples, modular homology or previously computed Buchsbaum labels. The precise bounded classification is useful without asserting a larger-parameter classification.
